channel.title: Joe — SysAdmin / Ops
channel.description: Ops + Microsoft change tracking + practical infra news.

item.title: ClickFix attack uses fake Windows BSOD screens to push malware
item.description:
A new ClickFix social engineering campaign is targeting the hospitality sector in Europe, using fake Windows Blue Screen of Death (BSOD) screens to trick users into manually compiling and executing malware on their systems. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: US broadband provider Brightspeed investigates breach claims
item.description:
Brightspeed, one of the largest fiber broadband companies in the United States, is investigating security breach and data theft claims made by the Crimson Collective extortion gang. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: VSCode IDE forks expose users to "recommended extension" attacks
item.description:
Popular AI-powered integrated development environment solutions, such as Cursor, Windsurf, Google Antigravity, and Trae, recommend extensions that are non-existent in the OpenVSX registry, allowing threat actors to claim the namespace and upload malicious extensions. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Ledger customers impacted by third-party Global-e data breach
item.description:
Ledger is informing some customers that their personal data has been exposed after hackers breached the systems of third-party payment processor Global-e. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Agentic AI Is an Identity Problem and CISOs Will Be Accountable for the Outcome
item.description:
As agentic AI adoption accelerates, identity is emerging as the primary security challenge. Token Security explains why AI agents behave like a new class of identity and why CISOs must manage their access, lifecycle, and risk. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: NordVPN denies breach claims, says attackers have "dummy data"
item.description:
NordVPN denied allegations that its internal Salesforce development servers were breached, saying that cybercriminals obtained "dummy data" from a trial account on a third-party automated testing platform. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Hackers claim to hack Resecurity, firm says it was a honeypot
item.description:
The ShinyHunters hacking group claims it breached the systems of cybersecurity firm Resecurity and stole internal data, while Resecurity says the attackers only accessed a deliberately deployed honeypot containing fake information used to monitor their activity. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Covenant Health says May data breach impacted nearly 478,000 patients
item.description:
The Covenant Health organization has revised to nearly 500,000 the number of individuals affected by a data breach discovered last May. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Cryptocurrency theft attacks traced to 2022 LastPass breach
item.description:
Blockchain investigation firm TRM Labs says ongoing cryptocurrency thefts have been traced to the 2022 LastPass breach, with attackers draining wallets years after encrypted vaults were stolen and laundering the crypto through Russian exchanges. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Over 10K Fortinet firewalls exposed to actively exploited 2FA bypass
item.description:
Over 10,000 Internet-exposed Fortinet firewalls are still vulnerable to attacks exploiting a five-year-old two-factor authentication (2FA) bypass vulnerability. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Google is testing a new image AI and it's going to be its fastest model
item.description:
Google is testing a new image AI model called "Nano Banana 2 Flash," and it's going to be as good as the Gemini 3 Pro Nano Banana, but it'll be cheaper. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer

item.title: Trust Wallet links $8.5 million crypto theft to Shai-Hulud NPM attack
item.description:
Trust Wallet believes the compromise of its web browser to steal roughly $8.5 million from over 2,500 crypto wallets is likely related to an "industry-wide" Sha1-Hulud attack in November. [...]
Source: BleepingComputer
